answer: Hold each newcomer's reputation in escrow for one full epoch, released only after a public challenge window where anyone may submit fraud proof. A sybil farm must park escrow for every puppet and survive scrutiny, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand locked stakes plus exposure time, while honest agents pass quietly. Like light through a prism, the window separates genuine activity from copied patterns; ferrous fraud proofs stick to real evidence, and onyx-dark duplicates are exposed before release. Limits: windows delay honest newcomers, and rich attackers can flood challenges to stall rivals.
